description_en: Queries the summary list of consumers in the console
description_zh: 查询消费者控制台汇总列表
name: ListConsumerConsoleSummaries

parameters.help_en: The target AI gateway instance ID. Consumer identities are shared across the region, and authorizations are isolated by instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标AI网关实例ID；消费者身份地域共享，授权按实例隔离
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy search keyword for the consumer name. This parameter does not change the total counts
parameters.help_zh: 消费者名称模糊搜索；不改变全量counts
parameters.name: name_like

parameters.help_en: The filter condition. Valid values: all, granted, and disabled. If this parameter is omitted, all is used
parameters.help_zh: 筛选条件：all、granted或disabled；省略按all处理
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter is required. Token-based pagination is used instead of pageNumber and pageSize
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Omit this parameter for the first page. For the last page, this value is empty or omitted
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的查询位置；首页省略，末页为空或省略
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The response status code. A value of Ok indicates success. If the call fails, a specific business error code is returned
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business data returned for the consumer operation
data.description_zh: 消费者操作返回的业务结果

complete.description_en: Indicates whether the query result is complete. A successful response returns a complete projection
complete.description_zh: 查询结果是否完整；成功响应返回完整投影

counts.description_en: The statistics of the complete consumer set in the local region. This value is not affected by the current pagination
counts.description_zh: 本地域完整消费者集合的统计，不受当前分页影响

all.description_en: The total number of readable consumers in the local region
all.description_zh: 本地域可读消费者总数

granted.description_en: The number of consumers that have authorization configurations in the current instance
granted.description_zh: 在当前实例存在授权配置的消费者数量

items.description_en: The list of consumers returned on the current page
items.description_zh: 本页查询返回的消费者列表

allModels.description_en: Indicates whether the authorization scope of this resource includes all models
allModels.description_zh: 该资源的授权范围是否包含全部模型

consumerGroups.description_en: The list of consumer groups that the consumer has joined
consumerGroups.description_zh: 消费者加入的消费者组列表

consumerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the consumer group

description.example: 用于业务接入的消费者。

joinTimestamp.description_en: The time when the consumer joined the consumer group. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
joinTimestamp.description_zh: 加入消费者组的时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

consumerId.description_en: The consumer ID returned by the create or query consumer API
consumerId.description_zh: 消费者 ID，使用消费者创建或查询接口返回的标识

createTimestamp.description_en: The time when the consumer was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
createTimestamp.description_zh: 消费者创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

credentials.description_en: The summary of credential types and quantities for the consumer. The actual credential content is not returned
credentials.description_zh: 消费者的凭证类型和数量摘要，不返回凭据内容

count.description_en: The number of credentials of this type

type.description_en: The credential type. Valid values: Apikey, Jwt, and AkSk. No keys or secrets are returned
type.description_zh: 凭证类型：Apikey、Jwt或AkSk；不返回任何Key/secret
type.title_en: 凭证类型：Apikey、Jwt或AkSk；不返回任何Key/secret。
type.title_zh: 凭证类型：Apikey、Jwt或AkSk；不返回任何Key/secret。

deployStatus.description_en: The deployment status of the consumer configuration. An empty string is returned if no deployment status is available
deployStatus.description_zh: 消费者配置的部署状态；没有部署状态时为空字符串

description.example: 用于业务接入的消费者。

enable.description_en: Indicates whether the consumer is enabled

localAccess.description_en: The number of authorization configurations in the current gateway, counted by resource type
localAccess.description_zh: 当前网关内按资源类型统计的授权配置数量

agentApis.description_en: The number of agent APIs that have authorizations configured
agentApis.description_zh: 已配置授权的 Agent API 数量

mcpServers.description_en: The number of MCP servers that have authorizations configured
mcpServers.description_zh: 已配置授权的 MCP 服务数量

modelApis.description_en: The number of model APIs that have authorizations configured
modelApis.description_zh: 已配置授权的模型 API 数量

otherGateways.description_en: The summary of access configurations for the consumer in other readable gateways
otherGateways.description_zh: 该消费者在其他可读网关中的访问配置摘要

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

updateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the consumer was updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
updateTimestamp.description_zh: 消费者更新时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
maxResults.description_zh: 单页最多返回的记录数量

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter when you query the first page
nextToken.description_zh: 上一页返回的分页标识；查询首页时不传入

totalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that match the current query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 匹配当前查询条件的记录总数

message.description_en: The response message that describes the result of the request
message.description_zh: 响应消息，用于说明请求处理结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID generated by the system to trace the call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用
